app_fee.value: Applicants for a doctoral or predoctoral programme are exempted from paying an application fee at KU Leuven.
app_fee.quote:
Who is exempted from paying the application fee?
Exemptions on paying the application fee are only granted to applicants:
for a (pre)doctoral programme

fee_waiver.value: Doctoral applicants are exempt from the application fee, so no fee is charged.
fee_waiver.quote:
Who is exempted from paying the application fee?
Exemptions on paying the application fee are only granted to applicants:
for a (pre)doctoral programme

gre_general.value: GRE General test is not required or mentioned for doctoral admission at KU Leuven.

toefl_min.value: KU Leuven requires a minimum TOEFL iBT overall score of 79 for English proficiency.

ielts_min.value: KU Leuven requires a minimum IELTS Academic overall band score of 6.5 for English proficiency.

english_waiver.value: English proficiency test is waived only for applicants who have obtained a previous diploma taught in English in Australia, English-speaking Canada, Ireland, New Zealand, the UK, or the USA.
english_waiver.quote: All applicants who have not obtained a previous diploma in a programme taught in English in Australia, English-speaking Canada, Ireland, New Zealand, the United Kingdom or the United States of America must submit one of the tests mentioned on this webpage, proving their proficiency in English.

notes: Doctoral education at KU Leuven is organized through doctoral schools including the Arenberg Doctoral School (Science, Engineering & Technology) and Biomedical Sciences Doctoral School. Applicants must secure a supervisor before applying.
